summary: PdfDing is a self-hosted document management tool designed for handling PDFs through a web interface. It provides functionality to view, edit, and organise PDF files across different devices. The application is packaged for containerised environments to simplify installation.
goodFor: It suits individuals and small teams looking for a lightweight, self-hosted option to manage and view PDF documents without relying on proprietary cloud services.
watchOut: The project has a moderate maintenance health score and an AGPL-3.0 licence, which may carry copyleft implications if you modify and distribute the code. It also competes in a crowded category with many mature document management alternatives.
deployNotes: Deployment relies on container runtimes like Docker or Kubernetes, so you will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your documents and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
